justification: Both depict human figures in carved relief with headgear and ornamental motifs, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a horizontal procession of profile figures leading a camel, framed by bands of rosettes, in a spare low-relief style with plain outlines; B shows a single frontal standing figure entirely enveloped in dense, deeply undercut scrollwork and mask-like ornament on a vertical monolith, with no shared arrangement, relationship or rendering convention.
